_README: THE BUILDER ROSTER AND EVERY WORD ON A BUILDER PAGE LIVES HERE.
Ranee, 2026-09-21: 'I want to add photos as we go along.' This file is how.
Edit it, run `python3 tools/build-builders.py`, commit. That regenerates the
builder cards on the home page, the Panorama Builders page, and every
find-a-home/builder-<slug>.html. Nothing on a builder page is hand-written.
THE FIELDS ARE RANEE'S BUILDER ASSET GUIDE, 1:1. A field left null renders
as a visible 'pending' marker naming what is missing -- it is NEVER filled
with plausible copy. The pages shipped before 2026-09-21 carried invented
floor plans ('The Vista, 4 beds, up to 3,600 sq ft') that no builder ever
supplied; that is what this file exists to make impossible.
NO FLOOR PLANS AND NO LOT ASSIGNMENTS. Ranee, 2026-09-21: 'We're not gonna
have any floor plans on the whole thing. No floor plans, no specific lots
for each builder. We're not gonna tell them where their lots are.' There is
deliberately no field for either. Do not add one.
NO LEAD CAPTURE. 'We're not gonna take tours. We're not gonna schedule
tours. We're not gonna do any kind of lead generation.' The only call to
action on a builder page is the link out to that builder's own website.

_assetGuide: THE FIELDS BELOW ARE RANEE'S 'BUILDER ASSET REQUEST' FLYER, 1:1.
BuilderAssets_Flyer_8.5x11_PAN_1.pdf, emailed 2026-09-21. She sends it to
each builder; their reply fills one object here. Keeping the shapes identical
is the whole trick -- a reply arrives in her field names, not ours.
1 Logos ............ logo (vector .ai/.eps/.svg preferred, transparent,
horizontal AND vertical if they have both)
2 Photography ...... exteriorImages / interiorImages, 1-5 each, 300 DPI,
horizontal preferred, min 6x4in
3 Marketing copy ... intro (<=50 words) - homes (2-4 paras, ~150 words,
SPECIFICALLY what they build at Panorama) -
differentiators (4-8 bullets) - url (+ utm)
4 Model homes ...... modelHomes[]: address, grandOpening (date AND time),
opensToPublic, estimatedCompletion
5 Delivery ......... assets go to Ranee@DAIUtah.com
6 Contact .......... contact{name,email,phone}
⛔ `contact` IS INTERNAL AND IS NEVER RENDERED. It is the builder's MARKETING
CONTACT, collected so Ranee can chase assets -- not a number for the public.
tools/build-builders.py must not read it, and lib tests pin that.
⛔ NOTHING BELOW IS FILLED IN YET. The flyer is the REQUEST; no builder has
